answer: I would stop farms with re-grading of panels below agreement floor, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. One honest agent clears the check in 15 minutes; a farm of 654 pays 9810 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. The plume sits in the mechanism itself, the forge sits in the price of faking it, and the voyage sits in the record no template can forge. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
